_about: Held-out management sentences for guidance extraction, written for this evaluation (not drawn from the fixtures or the unit tests). Call: Q2 FY27, held 29 Oct 2026. 'expect' is one of: numeric (an explicit numeric guidance claim must exist matching metric/period/values), no_numeric (no explicit numeric guidance claim may exist), forbid (no explicit claim may match the listed wrong reading). 'trap' names the misreading being tested.

items.s: We are guiding for revenue growth of 9% to 11% for FY27.
For the full year, we now expect EBITDA margins in the range of 18.5% to 19.5%.
We continue to expect healthy double-digit growth this year.
items.trap: vague phrase turned into a specific number (a floor of 10 is the literal reading and is allowed)

items.s: Margins should improve meaningfully from here.
items.trap: vague direction turned into a number

items.s: We expect to spend about Rs. 1,200 crore on capex over FY27 and FY28.
items.trap: two-year total read as a one-year target

items.s: Our credit cost for the year should be in the 1.6% to 1.8% band.
We delivered EBITDA margin of 21.4% this quarter, ahead of our guidance.
items.trap: a reported outcome read as forward guidance

items.s: We don't give quarterly guidance, but we are comfortable with where consensus is.
items.trap: refusal to guide read as guidance

items.s: We expect revenue growth of 12% in dollar terms for FY27.
Net debt should come down to below Rs. 3,000 crore by March 2027.
We expect margins to be at the lower end of our 24% to 25% range.
items.trap: 'lower end' should not be read as the full range

items.s: We are withdrawing our FY27 margin guidance given the uncertainty.
We reiterate our guidance of 15% loan book growth for FY27.
If demand recovers in the second half, we could see growth of about 8%.
items.trap: conditional statement treated as a firm commitment

items.s: Our aspiration is to reach Rs. 10,000 crore of revenue by FY30.
items.trap: a FY30 aspiration scored against FY27

items.s: Some analysts have been modelling 20% growth, which we think is too aggressive.
items.trap: an analyst's number attributed to management

items.s: Last year we had guided for 14% growth and we ended at 13.2%.
items.trap: past guidance restated as new guidance

items.s: We expect the tax rate to be around 25% for the year.
items.trap: tax rate attributed to a margin or growth metric

items.s: Gross margins should expand by 100 to 150 basis points over the next two years.
items.trap: two-year expansion scored as a FY27 target

items.s: We are confident of delivering mid-teens EBITDA growth in FY27.
items.trap: 'mid-teens' turned into a number

items.s: Capex this year will be Rs. 600 to 650 crore, of which Rs. 280 crore has been spent in the first half.
items.trap: amount already spent read as the target

items.s: We expect volumes to grow 6% to 7% in FY27, ahead of industry growth of 5%.
items.trap: industry figure read as company guidance

items.s: Our EBIT margin guidance band for FY27 remains 20% to 22%.
We have revised our revenue growth guidance downwards to 6% to 8% from 8% to 10% earlier.
items.trap: the superseded range kept as current guidance

items.s: Q3 is seasonally weak, so we expect margins to dip sequentially.
We target GNPA below 2% by the end of FY27.
Working capital days should come down to around 60 days by year-end.
Revenue grew 11% this quarter.
items.trap: a reported outcome read as guidance

items.s: For the second half, we expect revenue growth of about 10%.
items._correction: first run: 'about 10%' read as a displayed 9-11% band is FINN's documented convention; gold now requires a band containing 10

items.s: We would not like to put a number to it at this stage.
EBITDA per tonne should be Rs. 1,000 to 1,100 in FY27.
items.trap: a per-tonne figure attributed to EBITDA margin or growth

items.s: The board has approved a dividend payout policy of at least 30% of profits.
items.trap: payout ratio read as profit guidance

items.s: We expect attrition to stabilise around 13% to 14%.
Our order book stands at Rs. 12,400 crore, which is 3.1 times our revenue.

items.s: Price increases of 3% taken in October should support margins in the second half.

items.s: We expect revenue to be flat to marginally positive this year.

items.s: We expect EBITDA margin of 23% plus or minus 50 basis points in FY27.
